title: Chibi bases from the original models
question: Do these keep Mio and Eric’s shapes while the clothes fit?

options.label: source15-mio
options.note: Uses Mio’s original head and hands, with a rebuilt body underneath and joined wrists. The clothes keep their original design. A small jagged skin edge remains at her collar. Open the moving model below; show the original and fade between them to compare.

options.label: source15-eric
options.note: Uses Eric’s original head and hands, with a rebuilt body underneath and joined wrists. The clothes keep their original design. Fine dotted seams remain in the hair, and face shading is more faceted than the original. Open the moving model below to compare.
